data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old German elements bern (bear) and hild (battle, strife). The name Berns translates to 'bright as a bear'. This name was popular among Germanic tribes and has been used throughout history. The name Berns carries the meaning “Bright as a bear” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Berns usually hope their child will grow to embody bright as a bear and live with faith, good character and purpose.
